data.name: Ainiyah
data.gender_notes: Ainiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'awna', meaning 'to be pleasant, to be beautiful, to be gracious'. Ainiyah is a name that evokes a sense of beauty, grace, and loveliness. The name Ainiyah carries the meaning “Grace, beauty, lovely” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Ainiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, beauty, lovely and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ainiyah is a name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. It is said to represent the qualities of kindness, compassion, and beauty that are highly valued in the Islamic faith.
data.etymology: Ainiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, beauty, lovely.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ainiyah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
